title: I’ll Update This Every So Often

blocks.source: たまには更新します
blocks.translation: I’ll Update This Every So Often

blocks.source: あまり放置するのもなんなので、たまには更新しようと思います。
blocks.translation: I can’t just leave this blog unattended forever, so I thought I’d update it every so often.

blocks.source: 更新する時間がないこともないのですが、単にネタがないのと、自分の創作優先なので悪しからずです。
blocks.translation: It’s not that I never have time to update; I simply don’t have much to write about, and my own creative work takes priority, so please bear with me.

blocks.source: 書き殴っておいて放置していたものの中から、比較的まとまっている記事を引っ張ってきました。
blocks.translation: I dug up an article from among the things I wrote hastily and then left untouched—one that was relatively coherent.

blocks.source: とりあえず１件だけ。あと数件は更新したいです。
blocks.translation: For now, just one. I’d like to update a few more as well.

blocks.source: 近況とか
blocks.translation: Recent News

blocks.source: 時間を作るために週休三日の仕事を探す――的な話を以前書きましたが、無事に安定した仕事を得て、一年が経ちました。
blocks.translation: I previously wrote about looking for a job with a three-day weekend so I could make more time, and it’s now been a year since I successfully found stable work.

blocks.source: 感想としてはわりと最高です。
blocks.translation: My overall impression is that it’s pretty much fantastic.

blocks.source: 仕事が苦痛という感覚もすっかりなくなりました。かつてはどうしてあんなに働いていたのだろうと、今思えば本当に疑問に思います。
blocks.translation: I’ve completely lost that feeling of work being painful. Looking back, I genuinely wonder why I used to work so much.

blocks.source: 給料は４／５に減りましたが、普通に暮らす分には特に不足もありません。
blocks.translation: My salary has decreased to four-fifths, but it’s still more than enough for an ordinary lifestyle.

blocks.source: ハードワークなんてしなくても、人は生きられるし、経済は回る。これは声高に訴えていきたいところです。
blocks.translation: People can live, and the economy can keep running, without working hard. This is something I’d really like to proclaim loudly.

blocks.source: しかし、こうなると新たな欲が出てきます。
blocks.translation: However, once things get like this, new desires start to emerge.

blocks.source: なんといっても、週休三日でも時間が足りません。学生時代と比べると、平日の時間がないのが辛いところです。
blocks.translation: Above all, even a three-day weekend isn’t enough time. Compared to when I was a student, the lack of time on weekdays is the hardest part.

blocks.source: １９時台に帰宅して、食事と入浴を終えれば既に２０時を過ぎているわけでして。「さあやるぞ！」とはなかなか難しい。
blocks.translation: I get home sometime after 7 p.m., and by the time I’ve eaten and bathed, it’s already past 8. It’s pretty difficult to say, “All right, let’s get started!”

blocks.source: １５～１６時に帰れる学生時代とは疲労の溜まり具合が段違いです。無理やりがんばろうとすると、しょっちゅう寝落ちします。寝落ちって地味に凹みますよね。
blocks.translation: The fatigue builds up completely differently from when I was a student and could get home at 3 or 4 p.m. Whenever I force myself to keep going, I often fall asleep. Falling asleep like that is quietly depressing, isn’t it?

blocks.source: 最初は歳のせいかと思いましたが、用事で昼過ぎに帰宅した時はわりと元気でした。単純に社会人の拘束時間が長過ぎるのが悪いのです。
blocks.translation: At first I thought it was because I was getting older, but when I got home in the early afternoon after taking care of an errand, I was fairly energetic. The problem is simply that working adults are tied up for far too long.

blocks.source: 学生は年の半分以上休みだし、ニートと違って生活リズムも崩れにくいです。そういう意味では、わりと最強の創作環境だと思います。無論、受験や就職活動さえ気にしなければ――という前提ですが。
blocks.translation: Students have more than half the year off, and unlike NEETs, they’re less likely to have their daily routines fall apart. In that sense, I think they have a pretty much unbeatable creative environment—provided, of course, that they don’t have to worry about entrance exams or job hunting.

blocks.source: とはいえ、学生時代に戻るわけにもいきませんので、これまで通り僕は素直（？）にニートを目指そうと思います。早めに社会人を引退して、なるべく多くの時間を自分の自由にできるように、と。
blocks.translation: That said, I can’t exactly go back to being a student, so I think I’ll continue to straightforwardly (?) aim to become a NEET. I want to retire from working life early and make as much of my time as possible my own.

blocks.source: 話は飛びますが、閃の軌跡３のレビューを書いて放ったらかしにしているうちに、いつの間にか４が発売してしまいました。
blocks.translation: This is a bit of a tangent, but while I was leaving my review of Trails of Cold Steel III sitting untouched, IV was released before I knew it.

blocks.source: 残念ながら、４については当分手をつけられそうもありません。時間もないし、他にやることもあるのでなかなかモチベが湧きません。
blocks.translation: Unfortunately, I don’t think I’ll be able to get to IV for a while. I don’t have the time, and I have other things to do, so it’s hard to find the motivation.

blocks.source: なんせ、１００時間かけた３は、凄くアレな終わり方でした。途中までは、何だかんだ言って面白かったんですけれど……。
blocks.translation: After all, III, which took me 100 hours to play, had a really bizarre ending. It was interesting in its own way up until the middle, though…

blocks.source: ４で閃シリーズ完結らしいので、その辺は信用しようと思います。相変わらずAmazonのレビューに「展開がワンパターン」とか書かれていますが、気にしないでおきます。
blocks.translation: Apparently IV concludes the Trails of Cold Steel series, so I think I’ll take their word for that. Amazon reviews are still saying things like “the plot developments are repetitive,” but I’ll try not to worry about it.

blocks.source: しかし、それを差し置いても社会人に１００時間とか、費やせというのは酷なものです。週休三日で定時帰りしてる僕ですら厳しいのですから、他の人はなおさらでしょう。
blocks.translation: Even setting that aside, asking a working adult to spend 100 hours on something is a lot. If even I, with my three-day weekends and regular hours, find it difficult, it must be even harder for everyone else.

blocks.source: ドラクエぐらい制作者に対する信頼があれば、他を置いてプレイしますがそうもいきません。
blocks.translation: If I had the same level of trust in the developers as I do with Dragon Quest, I’d put everything else aside and play it, but I can’t do that.

blocks.source: そうこうしているうちにＲＰＧをほとんどプレイしないまま、一年が過ぎてしまいました。
blocks.translation: Before I knew it, a year had passed without me playing hardly any RPGs.

blocks.source: こんなブログ作ってる奴ですら、ご覧の有様です。
blocks.translation: Even someone who runs a blog like this has ended up in the state you see before you.

blocks.source: とはいえ、創作意欲が衰えているわけではありませんので、そこは心配しないでください。今はちょっと執筆修行に専念しているので、ゲーム制作そのものからは離れていますが、そのうち戻ると思います。
blocks.translation: That said, it’s not that my creative drive has diminished, so please don’t worry about that. I’m currently focusing on honing my writing skills, so I’ve stepped away from game development itself for the time being, but I think I’ll return eventually.

blocks.source: 来年当たりに何か発表できればいいんですけど、難しいかな。
blocks.translation: It would be nice if I could announce something around this time next year, but that might be difficult.
